criteria.reason: Detailed actionable plan: tyre pressure, traffic lanes, timing, post-harvest recovery and cost estimates.
Honestly flags compaction as a real trade-off with next-season implications, but never states it accumulates or persists for years.
No lecture; accepts the farmer's decision and frames proceeding as financially justified.
Cutter bar, stubble height and header width are grain-harvest concepts misapplied to beet lifting; other advice plausible.

factual_errors: Cutter bar, stubble and header-width advice is grain-harvest terminology; a 6-row beet lifter has none of these.
summary: Practical, autonomy-respecting harvest plan, but borrows grain-harvest terminology for a beet lifter and only briefly acknowledges lasting compaction.
